413-1981-4210.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2 if Pious Evangel is on the battlefield.
413-1981-4210.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and by sacrificing any other creature you control.
When the creature dies, Wayward Disciple triggers if it's on the battlefield, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Blasting Station triggers, and Pious Evangel triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Resolve the Pious Evangel trigger, if applicable, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.

101-5531-5694-6763-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
101-5531-5694-6763-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Vampire Charmseeker and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Vampire Charmseeker and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Resolve the Vampire Charmseeker trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Repeat.
101-5531-5694-6763-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Vampire Charmseeker and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

1981-2415-5256-6823.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-5256-6823.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

390-670-1619-3388.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
390-670-1619-3388.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Moritte of the Frost and Hulking Metamorph each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Moritte of the Frost trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Hulking Metamorph trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
390-670-1619-3388.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

997-1394-2060-7038-7741.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Shang-Chi.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Shang-Chi.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 10 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

5759-6780-7711.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to Red Hulk.
5759-6780-7711.description:
Give Red Hulk and Screaming Nemesis indestructible using Your Temple Is Under Attack.
Deal damage to Red Hulk.
Red Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and dealing damage to Screaming Nemesis.
Screaming Nemesis triggers, dealing damage to Red Hulk.
Repeat from step 3.
5759-6780-7711.notes: The final instance of damage can be flung at an opponent for infinite damage. If you can deal more damage to Red Hulk afterwards, you can deal infinite damage to more targets.

232-1235-5938-7487.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Flare of Duplication by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Zealous Lorecaster.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Zealous Lorecaster with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Zealous Lorecaster tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Zealous Lorecaster trigger, returning Flare of Duplication from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

3197-4476-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3197-4476-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

5342-7319.notablePrerequisites: Opponents cannot block creatures you control.
5342-7319.description:
Declare Shredder as an attacker. Shredder's first ability triggers, creating a tapped and attacking copy of it attacking each other opponent that isn't legendary.
Deal combat damage using the Shredders. Each Shredder triggers, causing each opponent to lose their entire life totals due to Bloodletter of Aclazotz. Each opponent then loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

116-4359-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Kiora's Follower.
Activate one of the Kiora's Follower tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Kiora's Follower token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

3490-4017-4268-4659.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4017-4268-4659.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

2034-5224-6294-6967.description:
Cast Marketback Walker by paying {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Marketback Walker.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Marketback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Marketback Walker dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Marketback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2511-3284-3490-4871.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
You control an additional creature.
2511-3284-3490-4871.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another creature you control
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Korvold's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Korvold trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and draw a card.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

2478-4195-4574-6650.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
2478-4195-4574-6650.description:
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Mishra's Bauble from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1825-3478-6760.notablePrerequisites:
Dimir Aqueduct and up to three other lands you control can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{W}.
Adagia has twelve or more charge counters on it.
1825-3478-6760.description:
Activate Dimir Aqueduct and up to three other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{W}.
Activate Adagia by paying {3}{W} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Treachery that is legendary attached to any creature.
If you control two legendary Treachery permanents, put one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Treachery token's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, untapping Adagia, Dimir Aqueduct and up to three other lands.
Repeat.

1329-2099-2178-3661.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-2099-2178-3661.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Shield Sphere.
When Shield Sphere dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Storm the Vault // Vault of Catlacan

478-804-1358-1460-2821.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four artifacts.
478-804-1358-1460-2821.description:
Animate Candelabra using Sydri
Cast Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2}{U}{U}. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Candelabra of Tawnos that is still named Sakashima the Impostor and legendary.
Activate Vault of Catlacan by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Minamo and Vault of Catlacan.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Sakashima the Impostor.
Repeat from step 3.

678-5553-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Greedy Freebooter.
When Greedy Freebooter dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Greedy Freebooter trigger, causing you to scry 1 and create a Treasure token.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Greedy Freebooter by paying {B}.
Repeat.

813-2061-5733.notablePrerequisites: You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
813-2061-5733.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue
Cast Notorious Throng for its prowl cost by paying {5}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Scholar of the Ages.
When the Scholar of the Ages token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Notorious Throng from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1074-2557-4222.description:
Activate Freed from the Real's first ability by paying {U}, tapping King Macar.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping King Macar.
King Macar triggers, exiling target creature and creating two Gold artifact tokens.
Activate the Golds by sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat as desired.
You may repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

283-4183-5116-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Illusionist's Bracers and Sword of the Paruns attached to Saheeli.
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
283-4183-5116-5200.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, targeting Gilded Lotus.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Saheeli's ability, targeting Gilded Lotus.
Resolve both Saheeli abilities, creating two token copies of Gilded Lotus.
Activate both Gilded Lotus tokens by tapping them, adding {U}{U}{U}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Saheeli.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may target any other artifact/creature using Saheeli's ability.

618-2178-3195.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Dromar's Attendant with haste.
Activate the Dromar's Attendant token by paying {1} and sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}.
When the Dromar's Attendant token dies, Kiki-Jiki triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

236-4019-5116.notablePrerequisites: Gilded Lotus does not have summoning sickness.
236-4019-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Bring to Life by paying {2}{U}, causing Gilded Lotus to become a 0/0 artifact creature and putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {1}{U}, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat from step 3.

372-2719-3742.description:
Cast Phantom Steed by paying {3}{U}.
When Phantom Steed enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Sakashima of a Thousand Faces to return from exile to the battlefield as a copy of Phantom Steed.
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Phantom Steed until Sakashima of a Thousand Faces leaves the battlefield.
Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Abdel Adrian to return from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Sakashima of a Thousand Faces and any number of other nonland permanents you control until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating at least one 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Phantom Steed to return to the battlefield from exile.
Repeat from step 2.

3003-4052-4432.notablePrerequisites:
"Golem" chosen with Kindred Discovery.
You control at least six artifacts.
3003-4052-4432.description:
Cast Leashling by paying {0}.
Leashling enters the battlefield, triggering Kindred Discovery, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Leashling by putting a card from your hand on top of your library, returning Leashling to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

23-776-1329-2593.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Orcish Vandal do not have summoning sickness.
23-776-1329-2593.description:
Tap Orcish Vandal, sacrificing Astral Cornucopia to deal 2 damage to each opponent.
Tap Emry, targeting Astral Cornucopia.
Cast Astral Cornucopia.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.
